question: When a planet revolves around the Sun, the gravitational force of attraction between them provides:
solution:
__**Concept:**__

**The universal law of gravitation**

__
 
• **Every object in the universe attracts every other object with a force** that is proportional to the product of their masses and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them.
 
• The force is **along the line joining the centres of two objects.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dec1bb62032b1f29d4469fff9d86f5d13e05977925779c55502042665612484d.png] 

 
• This is also called **Newton's universal law of gravitation.**
